# Copilot instructions

**Repository policy:** Read `AGENTS.md` first. It is mandatory project policy, not optional guidance.

Then read `docs/development/AI_CHANGE_PROTOCOL.md`, inspect Git history/status, and read the relevant architecture/data/feature documents before editing. After every completed change, update all affected documentation/tests/ADRs/PASS records, run validation, inspect `git diff`, and commit the validated state. Follow 2009Scape → OSRS Wiki → unknown and never reintroduce Ragger.
